echo_sets.name: Flamewing's Shadow + Flaming Clawprint
echo_sets.note: 3-pc: Echo Skill hits grant +20% Heavy Attack Crit Rate and Heavy Attack hits grant +20% Echo Skill Crit Rate for 6s; both active gives +16% Fusion DMG Bonus. Flaming Clawprint 2-pc adds +10% Fusion DMG. Corrosaurus (slotted as the 3-cost main echo) grants Fusion DMG and Echo Skill DMG Bonus.

echo_sets.name: Flamewing's Shadow + Molten Rift
echo_sets.note: Same core 3-pc buffs as best-in-slot; Molten Rift 2-pc gives the same +10% Fusion DMG if your Flaming Clawprint pieces are weaker.

echo_sets.name: Molten Rift
echo_sets.note: Pre-Rinascita fallback. 5-pc gives +30% Fusion DMG for 15s after a Resonance Skill; use only until the Flamewing's Shadow set is farmed.

build.fast_path: Give Galbrena Lux & Umbra (or a high-crit pistol alt), a 3-pc Flamewing's Shadow + 2-pc Flaming Clawprint/Molten Rift set with Corrosaurus as the 3-cost main echo, and aim for ~70-80% Crit Rate, >250% Crit DMG, and 120%+ Energy Regen. Main stats: Crit DMG (or Crit Rate) on the 4-cost, Fusion DMG on both 3-costs, ATK% on the 1-costs; prioritize Crit > Heavy Attack DMG Bonus > ATK% in substats.

ranked_weapons.name: Lux & Umbra
ranked_weapons.note: Best-in-slot. Crit DMG substat; passive grants ATK%, cross-buffs Heavy Attack and Echo Skill DMG amplification, and ignores part of enemy DEF when both buffs are active.

ranked_weapons.name: Phasic Homogenizer
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star pistol. Crit DMG substat with ATK and All-Attribute DMG on Tune Break; Game8's top non-signature alternative for her.

ranked_weapons.name: The Last Dance
ranked_weapons.note: Limited 5-star pistol. High raw Crit DMG makes it a strong fallback even though its passive does not synergize with her kit.

ranked_weapons.name: Static Mist
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star pistol. Crit Rate substat plus Energy Regen; reliable F2P-friendly fallback, roughly 80-83% of signature performance.

ranked_weapons.name: Solar Flame
ranked_weapons.note: Battle Pass 4-star pistol. Crit Rate substat with ATK and Heavy Attack DMG buffs; a solid mid-budget option.

stat_priorities.note: Use a Crit Rate 4-cost until ~70-80% Crit Rate is reached; her passive grants Crit DMG, so prioritize meeting the rate requirement first.
Second 3-cost; ATK% is acceptable if Fusion DMG pieces are weak. The main echo (Corrosaurus) is slotted on a 3-cost piece.

profile.role_note: On-field hypercarry with split Heavy Attack and Echo Skill scaling; teammate Echo Skill casts build her Afterflame before she enters Demon Hypostasis.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Galbrena is a top-tier Fusion hypercarry whose ceiling leans on her signature pistol Lux & Umbra and the Flamewing's Shadow 3+2 echo setup, so she is a strong pull if your account lacks a Fusion main DPS. She is hungrier for investment than some peers - premium teammates like Iuno, Lupa, or Qiuyuan plus Shorekeeper make her shine. With no active banner in Version 3.7, plan for a rerun and pre-farm her materials.

tier_badge.label: Meta-defining
tier_badge.note: Placed in the top DPS tier across current tier lists for her split Heavy/Echo scaling and extremely high damage output.

sequences.verdict: S0 is a complete kit. Grab Lux & Umbra first, aim S2 for the biggest jump, stop at S3 for value, S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Full Demon Hypostasis loop works at S0 - signature weapon first.
Burning Drive grants 350% more ATK Bonus - the single largest early DPS jump.
+130% Resonance Liberation multiplier; the best value-to-cost ratio.
Eternal Hypostasis: +60% enhanced-attack multipliers, up to +35% Fusion Deepen from Afterflame.
